question: What does the 'Processing' order status mean?
contexts:
Orders — Order statuses
"Processing" means the order is being packed and can still be changed. "Shipped" means it has
left the warehouse and has a tracking number. "Delivered" means the carrier confirmed delivery.
"Cancelled" means the order was stopped before shipping and has been refunded.

Orders — Changing or cancelling an order
An order can be changed or cancelled within 1 hour of being placed, while its status is
"Processing". After that, wait for delivery and start a return instead.

Orders — Order confirmation
An order confirmation email is sent within 15 minutes of purchase. Check the spam folder if it
does not arrive. The order ID starts with "PC-" followed by five digits.

Shipping — Tracking an order
A tracking link is emailed when the order ships. Tracking can take up to 24 hours to show the
first scan.
answer: The 'Processing' order status means the order is being packed and can still be changed. [orders-01]

question: I bought a jacket on sale 20 days ago. Can I still return it?
contexts:
Returns Policy — Sale and clearance items
Items bought on sale or from the clearance section can be returned within 14 days of delivery.
After 14 days, sale items are final sale and cannot be returned or refunded. Sale items that
arrive damaged or defective are covered by the warranty instead (see the warranty policy).

Returns Policy — Return window
Most items can be returned within 30 days of the delivery date. The item must be unused, clean,
and in its original packaging with all tags attached. The 30 days are counted from the day the
carrier marks the order as delivered, not from the order date.

Refunds — When refunds are issued
A refund is issued once the returned item reaches our warehouse and passes inspection, usually
within 3 business days of arrival. Orders that were never shipped are refunded as soon as they
are cancelled.

Product Care — Waterproof jackets
Wash waterproof jackets with a technical cleaner on a cool cycle, then tumble dry on low heat
for 20 minutes to restore the water-repellent finish. Re-proof the jacket once a season.
answer: No, you cannot return the jacket because items bought on sale can only be returned within 14 days of delivery. Since it has been 20 days, the sale item is considered final sale and cannot be returned or refunded [returns-policy-02].

question: Can you recommend a good hiking trail near Denver?
contexts:
Trailpoints Loyalty Program — Redeeming points
Every 500 Trailpoints can be redeemed for $10 off a future order. Points can be combined with
sale prices but not with other discount codes.

Trailpoints Loyalty Program — Earning points
Members earn 1 Trailpoint for every $1 spent. Sale and clearance items earn half points.
Gift card purchases do not earn points.

Warranty — Lifetime warranty
Pinecrest-brand trekking poles carry a lifetime warranty. If a pole section breaks during normal
use, we replace that section free of charge, for as long as the original buyer owns the poles.

Trailpoints Loyalty Program — Points expiry
Trailpoints expire 12 months after they are earned. Returning an item removes the points that
were earned on it.
